blind.description: A classical Roman or Greek style sculpted bust resting on a tall plinth. The upper portion is an off-white or ivory marble bust of a figure wearing a laurel wreath and draped robes, mounted on a small circular socle. The bust sits on a slender, dark green veined marble square pedestal with a stepped base and capital. The entire structure is clean, solid, and geometrically well-defined.
blind.from_above: Seen from directly above, the top of the curly, laurel-wreathed head is visible above draped shoulders, centered over the square top cap of the pedestal.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 to 4.5 feet tall (reaching roughly chest-height on the 5 ft 9 in marker figure) and about 1 foot wide at the base.
